classes.title: Classes
classes.subject: Subject
classes.checkFields: Not saved — review the highlighted fields
classes.noActiveTeachers: No active teachers available. Add or activate a teacher first.
classes.editNote: Subject and teacher can't be changed after creation.
classes.cancelWarning: Cancelling this course will unenroll all students. This can't be undone.
classes.unpricedBanner: Some classes have no monthly or per-session price — students cannot subscribe until you set one (edit the class).
classes.subtitle: A class with no price cannot be subscribed to. Set a monthly or per-session price to make it available.
classes.settlementBasisHint: This class carries a full-course price and a single-lesson price, and they can differ. This choice decides the amount distributed when each lesson is closed — it applies to future lessons only; lessons already settled never change.

rooms.priceHint: Shown to teachers when they book this room. This is not the revenue split.
rooms.methodsHint: One method = teachers must use it. Both = the teacher chooses when booking. All rates and percentages are set by the platform.
rooms.methodsRequired: Choose at least one pricing method
rooms.methodPerStudentUnavailable: Per-attending-student pricing is unavailable — the platform has not set its rate for this hall yet
rooms.methodPerStudentUnavailableEnabled: This method is enabled but the platform no longer sets a rate for it — the hall cannot be saved until you uncheck it
rooms.perStudentRateLabel: This hall's share per attending student
rooms.perStudentRateRequired: Enter this hall's share per attending student
rooms.perStudentRateFixedPercent: {value}% of the lesson price — set by the platform, not editable here
rooms.perStudentRateFixedFlat: {value} EGP per student — set by the platform, not editable here
rooms.perStudentRateHint: Frozen onto a class when it is created, so changing it never re-prices an existing class. Whatever is left after the platform's share goes to the teacher.
rooms.photoTooLarge: That image is too large (max {max} MB). Try a smaller one.
rooms.photoUnsupportedType: Unsupported image format. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF.
rooms.photoLimitReached: A room can have at most {max} photos.
rooms.photoUploadsUnavailable: Image uploads are not enabled on this server. Contact support.
rooms.photoAfterCreate: Save the room first, then add photos by editing it.
rooms.subtitle: Rooms and their prices drive what teachers see when requesting a collaboration. Changing a price does not touch existing classes.
rooms.totalRoomsFact: Each room is bookable by teachers.

fees.markAttendanceNow: Mark attendance for this session now (counter check-in)
fees.subCashHint: Cash is collected at the counter. The plan price configured on the course is charged — it activates immediately and writes the receipt + ledger entry.
fees.subMissingFields: Pick a student and a course
fees.subMissingSession: Pick a session for the per-session pass
fees.subtitle: Every amount here is written into a ledger that cannot be edited. The only correction after recording is a new reversing entry.
fees.walletFinality: A payout request reserves the amount from the center's balance immediately and is written to the ledger. It cannot be undone — only the platform can cancel it.
fees.walletConfirmFinal: Final confirm — press to record the request
fees.walletIndeterminate: The connection dropped before a reply — the request may already be recorded. Check “Recent payout requests” before retrying; do not press twice.
fees.writeIndeterminate: The connection dropped before a reply — the amount may already be recorded. Check the payment log before re-entering it; do not collect again.
fees.refundExceeds: More than the receipt's value. You cannot refund more than was collected.
fees.refundReasonPlaceholder: e.g. collected in error, student withdrew before the group started…
fees.refundReasonRequired: Enter a reason for the refund
fees.refundFinality: A refund is a new ledger entry and is never deleted — the original receipt stays visible, with a negative entry recorded beneath it and linked to it, and the amount returned is recorded on the original. It cannot be undone, and the student and their guardian are notified.
fees.refundConfirmFinal: Final confirm — press to record the refund
fees.creditArrearsHint: Your balance is negative — platform fees and teacher shares on cash-collected revenue are debited here. Top up to settle the arrears.
fees.creditTopupFailed: The top-up did not complete — try again.
fees.refundChannel: Where does the money go back?
fees.refundChannelHint_cash_drawer: You hand the cash over now. The drawer must be lighter by this amount at the end of the shift, and you record the signed voucher number afterwards.
fees.refundChannelHint_bank_transfer: You send the money to their account. Record the bank reference once the transfer is done.
fees.refundConfirmBody: Confirm that {amount} has actually been handed over. Only do this after the money has left.
fees.refundRefPlaceholder: Voucher number, or the bank transfer reference
fees.refundConfirmFinality: This records who confirmed it and when, and cannot be undone. A refund left unconfirmed shows up as a difference when the shift is counted.
fees.refundConfirmFinal2: Yes — the money has been handed over

expenses.subtitle: Expenses are deducted from the center's net profit in reports. Each entry is dated and counted once.

reports.subtitle: Every figure here is derived from the center's ledger and cannot be edited from this screen. Change the date range to recalculate.
reports.exportFailed: The export did not go through — nothing was downloaded. Please try again.
reports.exportPopupBlocked: Your browser blocked the print tab. Allow pop-ups for this site, then try again.

enroll.title: Enrollment Requests
enroll.declineReasonPlaceholder: e.g. Course is full, student doesn't meet prerequisites...
enroll.alreadyEnrolled: Student is already enrolled in this course
enroll.subtitle: Approving enrols the student immediately and opens attendance for them. Declining requires a reason, which is sent to the student.
enroll.selectHint: Decisions are made from this panel, not from table rows — so nothing is approved by a mis-tap while scrolling.
enroll.approveHint: Two steps: the first press arms the button, the second enrols.
enroll.approveArmedHint: The next press enrols the student and notifies them.
enroll.clearance: The class accepts a new enrolment and nothing blocks this student.

rejectReasonHint: A reason is required — it is emailed to the applicant.
noCentersDesc: New center registrations will appear here for review.

schedule.title: Session schedule
schedule.subtitle: A full week: every session in its hall, clashes marked.
schedule.clashCount: {n, plural, =0 {No clashes} one {# clash} other {# clashes}}
schedule.sessionsCount: {n, plural, =0 {No sessions} one {# session} other {# sessions}}
